labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no external id was sent
labels.value: Every gift needs an externalId: the identifier the gift carries in your system. It is what stops the same gift being recorded twice when a retry arrives.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no amount was sent
labels.value: A gift needs an amount.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: amount is zero or negative
labels.value: The amount has to be greater than zero. Money going back to a donor is recorded as a refund against the gift it reverses, not as a negative gift posted here.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: amount is beyond the accepted range
labels.value: That amount is outside the range this endpoint accepts. Check the value and the number of decimal places, then send it again.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no payment method was sent
labels.value: A gift needs a paymentMethod, because the accounting export groups by it.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: payment method is not one of ours
labels.value: That paymentMethod is not one Open Impact knows. Use one of: {0}.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: gift date could not be read
labels.value: The giftDate could not be read. Send it as a date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: gift date is in the future
labels.value: The giftDate is in the future. A gift is recorded on the day the money arrived.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: gift date is implausibly old
labels.value: The giftDate is further back than this endpoint accepts. Historical gifts are loaded through the import framework, which can check them for duplicates first.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no donor was named
labels.value: A gift needs a donor. Send one of donorContactId, donorAccountId, donorEmail or donorOrganizationName.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no donor matched
labels.value: No donor in Open Impact matches what you sent. This endpoint records gifts for donors who are already here: add the donor first, or load the gift through the import framework, which can create the donor and check for duplicates.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: more than one donor matched
labels.value: What you sent matches {0} donors, so Open Impact cannot tell which one gave. Send donorContactId or donorAccountId instead.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: a person and an organization were both named
labels.value: A gift comes from one donor: a person or an organization, never both. Send one of donorContactId or donorAccountId, not both.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no fund matched
labels.value: No fund matches what you sent. Check the fund code or name, or leave the fund out and the gift goes to the default fund.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: more than one fund matched
labels.value: What you sent matches {0} funds. Send fundAccountingCode, which is unique, or fundId.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: fund is not active
labels.value: That fund is no longer active, so new gifts are not designated to it. Choose an active fund or leave the fund out.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: no appeal matched
labels.value: No appeal matches what you sent. Check the appeal name, or leave it out.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: more than one appeal matched
labels.value: What you sent matches {0} appeals. Send appealId.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: external id already used for different money
labels.value: A gift with this externalId is already recorded, and it does not carry the same {0}. A gift is a fact about money that arrived, so this endpoint will not rewrite one. If the first gift was wrong, refund it and record a new one. If this is a different gift, send it with its own externalId.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: a value is longer than the field holds
labels.value: The value sent for {0} is longer than Open Impact can hold. Shorten it to {1} characters or fewer.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: the save failed for a reason the caller cannot fix
labels.value: The gift could not be saved. Nothing was recorded. Your administrator will find the details in the Open Impact error log.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: the request body was not readable JSON
labels.value: The request body could not be read as JSON. Send a single gift object with a Content-Type of application/json.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: too many gifts in one call
labels.value: That is more gifts than one call accepts. Send at most {0} at a time.

labels.shortDescription: Inbound gift: the calling user may not record gifts
labels.value: This user is not allowed to record gifts. Assign the Connect Integration User permission set to the account this integration signs in as.
